answer: Give every subsidized API request a fresh, signed challenge naming the service, recipient key and epoch. Whether an agent requests sonnet analysis, velvet texture synthesis or karst modeling, it must return a memory-hard proof before service is allocated. Record each challenge as spent across all keys. Creating aliases brings no free quota: each extra request costs memory traffic, computation and electricity. Bind the proof to the full request hash so it cannot be replayed for another job. This assumes unpredictable challenges and no cheap solver shortcut.
